title: UI floor findings
description: The elements of one rendered page that break a line of vstack's design floor a script can see.

widths.description: The viewport widths the page was loaded at, in pixels.

line.description: The floor line's number in vstack's principle-design-floor table: 4 overlap or clipping, 6 colors, 7 hard to read, 8 emoji as icons.

selector.description: A short CSS path to the element, up to four levels or the nearest id.

detail.description: The evidence: the text, the contrast ratio, the property, or the overflow.

widths.description: The widths at which the element broke the line.

cacheHit.description: Always false. The page is loaded fresh on every call.
